policy: At each cadence tick, dispatch at most one currently dispatchable vehicle; no click when none is available. First opportunity is tick 0. Random LCG generates one ordering key per vehicle on every cadence decision.

metrics.stars: Production stars(maxWait): maximum simulated time until a group starts boarding, not completion time.
metrics.queuedVehicles: Assigned, uncleared services whose vehicle is not the current owner of its assigned bay; sampled after every dispatch and 0.05s simulation step.
metrics.trafficBlockedVehicles: Driving/departing services with waitingForTraffic=true; sampled after every dispatch and simulation step.
metrics.ranking: Incomplete first, then smallest three-star margin, greatest queued/traffic-blocked peaks, longest duration, stable level/order tie-break. Review priority, not proof of a gameplay defect.
